title: Find the tipping point in mycelium networks
hook: Many systems change gradually until one threshold causes a disproportionate shift. This prompt asks where that threshold might be.
experiment: Represent modules as a ring graph with local dependencies. Remove nodes at random and measure the largest surviving connected subsystem across repeated trials.
question: Can local rules create robust global coordination?
caveat: Graph-connectivity analogy only; it does not simulate packet routing, delivery success, neural activity or biological adaptation.

lenses.task: Map the system boundary, key components, feedback loops and possible bottlenecks.
State one observation that would weaken this hypothesis. Identify a competing explanation.
Choose a control condition, change one variable, and define a measurable outcome before running the test.
